title: Wakesurf Boat on Lake Austin - BYOB Captained (up to 12 guests)
blurb:
This is a Captained Wakesurf Boat Rental so you can safely enjoy your Watersports activities. 

This Axis A24 is the best boat for Wakesurfing, wakeboarding, waterskiing or tubing. Has amazing wakesurf technology that mimics surfing on waves in the ocean. All equipment and life vest included. All levels from beginner to expert are welcome. Lessons are included. 

It’s great for all occasions:
- Bachelor or Bachelorette parties
- Birthdays
- Work events
- Family reunions 
- Wakesurf trips and lessons

15 min from downtown Austin. 

Don’t miss out! Also explore the stunning Texas Hill Country with views of the Luxurious Lakeshore Realestate, Austin Country Golf Course, 360 bridge, Iconic Lakeside Restaurants, Party Cove and more.. 

Loaded up with speakers so bring your favorite playlist! See you soon at the lake
